sources.quote: Theta Coronae Australis, also named Bie, is a solitary yellow-hued star located in the southern constellation of Corona Australis.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 441 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,934 K, so 28.774 solar radii.
